Remarkably, this metaphor nearly always carries negative connotations: in Amos 7:16 and Micah 2:6, opponents tell the prophets to stop 'dripping' their unwanted messages. Spanish captures the split neatly, using 'destilar' (to distill) for the physical and 'profetizar' (to prophesy) for the figurative. French similarly distinguishes 'distiller' from 'prophetiser.'"

This bridges the physical and figurative uses of the root.
